summary: St. Tammany Parish steel tower three miles south of Abita Springs, with a grey cab the NGS description gives as 100 feet (about 30 m, if that is the whole height); Wikipedia says still standing and owned and used by the state Department of Agriculture. No build date found.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence and no build date. The Wikipedia row for Abita reads Still standing; adjacent rows in the same table read Torn down, which is why the first grep was misleading. The 100-foot figure is ambiguous (cab or whole structure); height_m 30.5 follows the 100-foot figure. OSM tags it as an observation tower with lattice construction at 9 m elevation. The record's agency 7N is a survey location, not an agency. One web search found nothing on Morgan Road or the tower's use. The story is short by design; do not pad it.
